project_type: Node.js CLI Tool with Desktop App (Electron + Vue 3)
language: JavaScript (ES6+), with Vue 3 for desktop app
build_system: npm with Vitest for testing, Vite for desktop app, Makefile for Debian packages
test_framework: Vitest with v8 coverage, Playwright for E2E tests in desktop app
build_command: npm run build (no-op for CLI), npm run build in desktop-app for Vite build
test_command: npm test (vitest run), npm run test:all for comprehensive suite
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm test to verify 950+ tests pass (currently 2 minor test failures in logger tests) 2. Run npm run lint after ESLint migration to verify flat config works 3. Test CLI: node bin/cli.js --help 4. Test API server: npm run serve (optional manual test)
snapshot_or_generated_files: No snapshot files. Generated files: token-analysis-report.json, llm-context.json, digest.txt - all are user outputs, not checked in
setup_instructions: 1. npm install 2. Tests should pass (950+ pass, 2 minor logger test failures acceptable)
environment_constraints: Node.js >=20.0.0 required. 30 security vulnerabilities detected (22 high, 4 critical) - need npm audit fix. ESLint 9.39.1 installed but using old .eslintrc.json format - needs flat config migration.
contribution_requirements: Pre-commit hook runs lint-staged. Pre-push hook runs npm test. CI runs on Node 20.x and 22.x. NPM publish uses OIDC Trusted Publishing.
key_patterns: ES6 modules (type: module in package.json). Export pattern: index.js exports public API. Core modules in lib/: analyzers, parsers, formatters, utils, core, plugins, api, cache, watch, rag. Plugin architecture for languages and exporters. Test files in test/ with *.test.js naming.
directory_structure: Root: CLI tool entry points (index.js, ctxman.js, bin/cli.js). lib/: core modules (analyzers, parsers, formatters, utils, core/, plugins/, api/, cache/, watch/, rag/, integrations/). desktop-app/: Electron + Vue 3 app (main/, renderer/, e2e/, test/). test/: 77 test files. docs/: documentation and content. scripts/: install/uninstall scripts. .github/workflows/: CI and NPM publish.

modernization_findings.eslint: ESLint 9.39.1 installed but using deprecated .eslintrc.json. Needs migration to flat config (eslint.config.js).
modernization_findings.express: Express 5.1.0 is a release candidate with potential stability concerns. Consider documenting or downgrading to 4.x.
modernization_findings.react: React 19.2.0 - major version, check compatibility with Ink 6.4.0.
modernization_findings.zod: Zod 4.1.12 - major version, may have breaking changes from v3.
modernization_findings.security: 30 vulnerabilities (22 high, 4 critical) in dependencies - hono, @hono/node-server, brace-expansion, form-data, flatted, fast-uri, @modelcontextprotocol/sdk, ajv, body-parser, @protobufjs/utf8.
modernization_findings.test_failures: 2 minor test failures in logger tests (case sensitivity and mock assertion) - acceptable for now but should fix.
modernization_findings.typescript: No TypeScript currently. Pure JavaScript codebase. Could benefit from TypeScript migration for better tooling.
modernization_findings.ci_cd: Basic CI with test and lint. Could add security scanning, dependency updates, release automation.
modernization_findings.desktop_app: Electron 39.2.3, Vue 3.5.24, Vite 7.2.4 - all current versions. Good state.
